# La Union Gateway

Website: https://launiongateway.com/

La Union Gateway is a discovery platform for accommodations and travel-related businesses across La Union, Philippines.

Its purpose is to help travelers discover places to stay in La Union and connect directly with accommodation providers.

Main accommodation categories include:
- Beach Resorts
- Hotels and Resorts
- Hotels
- Transient Houses
- Hostels
- Villas
- Apartelles
- Guest Houses
- Boutique Hotels

The platform covers municipalities and destinations across La Union, including San Juan, San Fernando City, Bauang, Bacnotan, Luna, Agoo, and other municipalities in the province.

Primary website sections:
- Home
- Stays
- Explore
- List Your Business
- About

For accommodation owners:
La Union Gateway allows businesses to showcase their accommodation and help travelers discover their property.

Canonical website:
https://launiongateway.com/
